enabled.description: Enable or disable the greylisting daemon.

socket_path.description: Unix socket path used for communication with Postfix.

db_dir.description: Directory where greylist state is persisted.

db_type.description: Database backend type: 'sqlite' for persistent storage, or 'memory' for volatile (non-persistent) operation.

db_file.description: Path to SQLite database file (used only if db_type = 'sqlite').

expires.description: Time (in seconds) after which greylist entries expire (i.e., mail is no longer deferred).

retry_delay.description: Minimum delay (in seconds) before a second attempt from a new sender is accepted.

max_retry_delay.description: Maximum delay (in seconds) before repeated greylisting attempts are relaxed.

delay.description: Initial deferral delay (in seconds) applied to first-time senders.

whitelist_networks.description: List of CIDR network ranges to exempt from greylisting (e.g., internal mail servers).

items.description: A single IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR network (e.g., '192.168.0.0/24', 'fd00::/48').

dnsbl_whitelist.description: DNSBL zones whose hosts are automatically whitelisted (if supported by greylistd version).

items.description: Domain name of a DNSBL zone (e.g., 'zen.spamhaus.org').

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging: debug, info, notice, warning, error, or critical.

log_file.description: Path to log file (use '-' to log to stderr/stdout).

rate_limit.description: Enable rate limiting per source IP to prevent abuse (e.g., brute-force greylist bypass attempts).

rate_limit_max.description: Maximum number of connections per source IP per rate limit window (only when rate_limit = true).

rate_limit_window.description: Time window (in seconds) for rate limiting (only when rate_limit = true).

syslog.description: Log greylisting events to syslog in addition to configured log file.

experimental.description: Enable experimental features (use only if instructed by docs or developers).

custom_headers.description: Optional custom headers to include in greylisting rejection responses.

items.description: A header key-value pair to append to SMTP responses.

value.description: Header value (may include variables like %s for sender).
